text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One night, Mejiro Dober asks me to come with her to speak with Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She thanks Air Groove for guiding her all this time, handing her a single flower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The flower is a yellow carnation—a declaration of challenge to Air Groove and a promise that Mejiro Dober will surpass her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove willingly accepts her challenge and promises to see her again at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Relieved she was able to voice her desires in front of both Air Groove and me, a smile spreads across Mejiro Dober's face.
